newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Cesp still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cesp still a buy.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said in a report it maintained its buy rating on Sao Paulo state-owned power utility Cesp shares.

-- Analyst Rosana Aldworth said the company's restructuring efforts ahead of privatization had significant results as Cesp had multiplied its earnings before income tax (EBIT) by almost 2.7 times in 1996.
-- "We expect the restructuring to continue to enhance the bottom line, with EBIT margin forecast to reach 32.2 percent by 2000 against 1996's 27.5 percent," Aldworth said.
-- She also said Cesp's outstanding debt should be lowered through the sale of its subsidiaries CPFL and Comgas, expected for the second half of 1997.
-- "The debt/equity ratio could thus fall from the current 62.4 percent to about 30 percent," she added.
-- Cesp preferred stock closed at 56.98 reais, up 0.07 percent.
